name: A. Osborne
role: Rancher of the Ætna ranch on Andrews Creek
bio: A. Osborne put a bunch of cattle on Andrews Creek in August 1885 and warned that the cattle disease at Sentinel Butte was contagious. By early 1886 he was running the Ætna ranch and was a strong champion of black Polled-Angus cattle.
mentions: A. Osborne has put in a bunch of cattle on Andrew's creek and will add to his stock next spring.

The cattle disease at Sentinel Butte is still unchecked. Only nine or ten head have died, but A. Osborne, who has a small bunch of cattle on Andrews creek states that the disease is contagious. In any event, something should be done immediately, as prevention is far better…
A. Osborn has eight dozen chickens that he will dispose of at reasonable figures. Word can be left at this office.
A. Osborne was in yesterday from the Ætna ranch and is as much pleased with the condition of his cattle as are the men on the river.
